programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Rayo Vallecano - Valencia 21.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: LaLiga Talking Football

programme.title: Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga: Brighton - U. Craiova
programme.desc: Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Juventus - Omonia
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year.

programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football: HNL: Istria - Varaždin
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Danny Lee, Jason Pai and Sun Chien play newly-recruited law enforcers whose crime-fighting is hampered by their corrupt superiors, in this period-set martial arts thriller.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword. Assistant director Wang Po-yi also wrote this entertaining and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Tang Peng Nan are a sweet couple. She sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan at a time when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by him, leading to their break up.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: The evil minister uses the twelve golden medallions, the highest imperial decree, to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu plays the son of a police chief, who falls for a sexy dancing girl and gambles for cash. When the girl is raped he swears to defy his father and seek revenge!

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: With the destruction of the Shaolin Temple, five students must each learn Shaolin techniques in order to defeat their Ching adversaries. But there's a ''traitor'' amongst them, but who is it?

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist kills his master and entire clan, the Iron Buddha sets out for revenge. He'll need a magic sword first though, naturally.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take it back.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Action maestro Chang Cheh tells the story of Chin Feng, who meets the beautiful Ting Hung while on the run for accidentally killing an arrogant bully.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score 'The Proud One'. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women give birth to baby girls by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody Of Love
programme.desc: This delightful romance story tells the story of three doctors pursuing three beauties who play hard-to-get in the 'a-go-go' era of the 70s.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: The 70s idol Hsing Hui and Yon Fan star in this horror movie. Young business man marries pretty, young bride, never knowing that she carries the spirit and everything starts there.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful young fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealousy and a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: Swordsman At Large
programme.desc: Bandits, beauties, and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang-lung both work as guards for the Tien Ying Treasury House, an establishment that offers its clients storage and safe transportation for their money or valuables.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Alex is happily married to a gynecologist, Tung for five years. When Alex is fatally wounded in an accident, he feels obliged to tell Tung about his affair with Blackie.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself, a courtesan in love with a general and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Inspired by the relationship between Stanly Ho and his fourth wife, Angela, it's a romantic comedy about a billonaire who falls in love with a feisty casino dealer.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: Gorgeous (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: Ip Man (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: My Darling Genie

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Shaolin (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 2
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Blade II: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Blade bekerja sama dengan musuh bebuyutannya untuk memerangi vampir generasi baru yang tidak hanya mengancam umat manusia, tetapi juga vampir lainnya.

programme.title: Arcadian
programme.desc: Paul dan kedua putra remajanya, Thomas dan Joseph, telah menjalani setengah kehidupan – ketenangan di siang hari dan siksaan di malam hari.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Colin Farrell and Jennifer Aniston are three Horrible Bosses whom their subordinates are trying to get rid of... permanently.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: In the sequel to the 2011 hit comedy, Kurt, Nick and Dale decide to set up their own business. An investor outplays them, leaving their new start-up in dire straits.

programme.title: Path to War
programme.desc: Presiden Johnson dan tim kebijakan luar negerinya berjuang dengan keputusan untuk mengakhiri perang Vietnam dalam film HBO Original ini.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: Seorang pahlawan perang yang berprestasi kembali ke kampung halamannya hanya untuk terseret kembali ke medan perang, menguji keteguhannya terhadap kehidupan, cinta, dan keluarga.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: Setelah diberkahi dengan kekuatan oleh para Dewa Mesir dan menghabiskan 5.000 tahun di tempat terisolasi, Black Adam bebas dan memutuskan menegakkan keadilan di dunia dengan caranya sendiri.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: Pada musim panas tahun 1979, sekelompok sahabat menyaksikan suatu kecelakaan kereta dan menyelidiki kejadian aneh yang terjadi setelahnya di kota kecil mereka.

programme.title: Something the Lord Made
programme.desc: Dua pria mencapai terobosan medis besar yang membuat salah satunya mendapatkan penghargaan dan yang lainnya mendapatkan pelajaran menyakitkan tentang kesempatan yang tidak setara.

programme.title: Boycott
programme.desc: Boikot selama 13 bulan terhadap penggunaan layanan bus di Alabama setelah seorang wanita kulit hitam menolak menyerahkan kursinya kepada seorang pria kulit putih.

programme.title: Clear History
programme.desc: Setelah bertengkar dengan bosnya, Nathan mengubah identitasnya untuk menghindari penghinaan publik – tetapi kemudian mendapati masa lalunya mengganggu kehidupan barunya.

programme.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
programme.desc: Sebuah kecerdasan buatan yang jahat menculik putra pemain basket terkenal LeBron James, yang kemudian harus bekerja sama dengan Looney Tunes untuk memenangkan pertandingan basket.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Borussia Mönchengladbach - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund przed 10. kolejką ma na koncie 21 punktów - tyle samo co lider, Bayern Monachium. Obie ekipy będą faworytami swoich kolejnych spotkań. Dortmundczycy zmierzą się z zamykającą tabelę Borussią Mönchengladbach. Będzie to dla nich szansa na rewanż za ostatnie bezpośrednie starcie, w którym przegrali 0:1.

programme.title: Formuła 1: Grand Prix Las Vegas
programme.desc: Mistrz jest już znany - został nim Kimi Antonelli. Wciąż toczy się jednak rywalizacja o wicemistrzostwo F1. Kto po wyścigu na torze w stolicy hazardu będzie bliżej sukcesu - Lewis Hamilton czy Max Verstappen, który GP Las Vegas wygrał już dwa razy?

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Parma Calcio 1913 - AS Roma
programme.desc: AS Roma nadal nie przegrała żadnego spotkania w lidze w tym sezonie, a tę imponującą serię spróbuje przerwać Parma w najbliższym meczu u siebie. Goście ostatnio pokonali Sassuolo 3:0, natomiast gospodarze ulegli Bolognie 1:2.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Bayern Monachium - 1. FC Köln
programme.desc: W obozie Bawarczyków nie brakowało ostatnio problemów zdrowotnych. Dotknęły one też Vincenta Kompany'ego, który zasłabł na treningu. Jest jednak szansa, że Belg poprowadzi drużynę w meczu z FC Köln. Ewentualne potknięcie w konfrontacji z Kozłami może sprawić, że Bayern straci pozycję lidera Bundesligi na rzecz Borussii Dortmund.

programme.title: Olympique Lyon - Między legendą a teraźniejszością
programme.desc: Olympique Lyon to jeden z najsłynniejszych klubów we Francji. Jego złota era przypadła na pierwszą dekadę XXI wieku, kiedy to siedmiokrotnie sięgnął po mistrzostwo Ligue 1. Twórcy filmu przypominają tamte sukcesy i przedstawiają wyzwania obecnie stojące przed Les Gones.

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: AC Monza w poprzedniej kolejce musiała uznać wyższość Atalanty BC, przegrywając 0:1. Dla Biancorossich była to już czwarta ligowa porażka z rzędu. Przełamania będą teraz szukać w starciu z ACF Fiorentiną, choć zadanie nie wydaje się łatwe. Mimo że Fioletowi mieli w tym sezonie swoje problemy, ostatnio punktowali w trzech kolejnych spotkaniach, notując dwa remisy i zwycięstwo.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa

O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

A series of freeway car accidents leads to a catastrophic overpass collapse that endangers the lives of civilians and members of the 118.
Athena and Bobby set off on their honeymoon cruise, but when duty calls, their vacation is put on hold; a fighter jet traps a civilian; an unusual incident leaves a couple stuck together.

The disastrous cruise continues when Bobby and Athena respond to the ship's explosion, racing to aid injured passengers; Hen questions her instincts in a life-taking call and grows concerned about Athena and Bobby's whereabouts.

With each moment becoming critical as the ship flips upside down, Athena and Bobby take charge, seeking methods for rescue while navigating efforts to guide survivors to safety; Hen defies protocols in her search for Bobby and Athena.

Eddie and Buck's flight back to Los Angeles is cancelled following the National Firefighter Games; hoping to be home for Hen's birthday, Eddie and Buck decide a cross-country road trip is the fastest way, until Buck goes missing.
Buck tries to manage the trauma following his kidnapping on his own; May tries to secure her first law internship without the help of her mother.

After years of anticipation, Maddie and Chimney's long-awaited wedding day arrives; when the groom mysteriously vanishes, the 118 races against time to ensure he doesn't miss the most crucial day of his life.
Maddie and Athena investigate a case surrounding an abducted mother and child; Hen and Karen learn more about Mara's family history; Eddie grapples with unresolved feelings for someone from his past.

After a victim of the apartment fire that changed Bobby's life resurfaces, he searches to make amends; driven by his need to right past wrongs, Bobby delves deep into memories of his childhood, unearthing moments from his fractured past.

The 118 and Tommy are presented with the Medal of Valor for their work on the cruise ship rescue; Hen and Karen encounter an unforeseen hurdle in their foster care journey; Eddie's emotional affair develops further.

Following the devastating fire at the Nash home, Bobby's fate remains uncertain; Athena embarks on a mission to uncover the truth; Hen and Karin engage in a heated custody battle; Christopher grapples with forgiving Eddie.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Sebening Embun (Rr)
programme.desc: Perjuangan tulus seorang gadis cilik bernama Intan dalam merawat ibunya, Nayla, yang mengalami gangguan jiwa akibat trauma masa lalu. Meskipun Nayla kerap bersikap dingin dan tidak mengakuinya sebagai anak, Intan tetap setia mendampingi dan menyayanginya dengan penuh kesabaran. Di tengah keterbatasan tersebut, kehidupan mereka semakin diuji oleh kemunculan rahasia asal-usul keluarga, pengkhianatan orang-orang terdekat, serta berbagai konflik yang memisahkan mereka, namun kasih sayang Intan terus menjadi harapan utama bagi kesembuhan sang ibu.

programme.title: Cinta Sebening Embun
programme.desc: Intan, seorang gadis kecil berjuang merawat ibunya yang tidak pernah mengakuinya sebagai anak, karena kondisinya yang mengalami gangguan jiwa.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Tanpa Karena (Rr)
programme.desc: Perjalanan cinta Nuna dan Dipta harus menghadapi jalan yang terjal. Mulai dari terhalangnya restu orang tua, jarak yang memisahkan, hingga rasa cemas karena Dipta merupakan seorang abdi negara yang setiap harinya harus mempertaruhkan nyawa. Berbagai rintangan pun menguji kesetiaan cinta mereka.

programme.title: Cinta Tanpa Karena
programme.desc: Dipta adalah anggota satuan khusus yang punya kekasih cantik bernama Nuna. Cinta mereka sangat kuat meski rencana pernikahannya tak dapat restu dari orang tua. Belum lagi rencana perjodohan Nuna bersama seorang pengusaha sukses bernama Ghani. Sampai suatu ketika Dipta terpaksa harus bertugas ke luar kota, tapi tanpa disangka tragedi besar terjadi tepat saat Nuna positif hamil.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Go Spot Ekslusif (RCTI)
programme.desc: Go Spot Eksklusif menyajikan liputan khusus seputar dunia hiburan, kisah para selebritas, serta berita eksklusif dan inspiratif yang dikemas ringan, menarik, dan informatif.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Kompilasi perjalanan cinta Aldebaran dan Andin yang penuh lika-liku, mulai dari kesalahpahaman, pengorbanan, hingga perjuangan mempertahankan keluarga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Tertulis Untuk Kita (Tayang Perdana)
programme.desc: Kencana menyelidiki pembunuhan ayahnya yang ternyata melibatkan Hardiman, pengusaha sukses yang ternyata juga memiliki hubungan dengannya. Dalam prosesnya, Kencana bekerja sama dengan Glen, yang juga menyimpan dendam terhadap Hardiman atas kematian kakaknya dan pencurian desainnya. Keduanya berusaha membongkar kejahatan Hardiman, di tengah konflik keluarga, persaingan bisnis, dan kisah cinta yang tumbuh di antara mereka.

programme.title: Tertulis Untuk Kita (RCTI)
programme.desc: Ketika dua hati dipertemukan, sementara masa lalu belum usai dan masa depan penuh akan tanda tanya. Ada rahasia yang tersimpan, luka yang terpendam, dan takdir yang tak bisa dihindari. Akankah pertemuan mereka membawa kebahagiaan atau justru menghadirkan luka baru?

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Sera harus menanggung kesalahan yang tidak pernah ia perbuat, sementara Kenzi menyimpan rasa bersalah atas kejadian yang mengubah hidup Sera. Saat kebenaran mulai terungkap, apakah semuanya masih bisa diperbaiki?

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Amira perempuan cantik, baik hati, dan selalu positif dalam memandang hidup. Kehidupannya berjalan baik-baik saja namun setelah kematian suami dan putrinya serta masalah yang datang bertubi-tubi membuatnya menjadi semakin terpuruk untuk melanjutkan hidupnya.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)
programme.desc: Pihu, arwah seorang anak perempuan berusia tujuh tahun, berusaha melindungi ibunya, Anandita, dari segala bahaya dengan bantuan teman sekaligus anak baptisnya, Krishna.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)
programme.desc: Pihu, arwah seorang anak perempuan berusia tujuh tahun, berusaha melindungi ibunya, Anandita, dari segala bahaya dengan bantuan teman sekaligus anak baptisnya, Krishna.

programme.title: Terikat Takdir
programme.desc: Bhootu adalah hantu kecil yang ceria dan senang membantu orang lain. Meski niat baiknya sering menimbulkan kejadian lucu dan masalah tak terduga, ia selalu membawa kebahagiaan bagi orang-orang di sekitarnya.

programme.title: Jangan Bercerai Bunda
programme.desc: Nabilla, seorang ibu dan pengusaha yang memiliki tiga orang anak. Dalam perjalanan rumah tangganya bersama Arga sang suami, lika-liku pun hadir menghampiri. Terungkapnya kejadian bahwa Arga berselingkuh bersama wanita lain membuat Nabilla terdesak dalam kondisi penuh pilihan.

programme.title: RCTI
programme.desc: RCTI menawarkan beragam program termasuk serial drama, film box office, acara olahraga, pencarian bakat, reality show dan musik, program ulang tahun dan penghargaan, serta berbagai infotainment.

programme.title: Anak Jalanan
programme.desc: Boy, pemimpin geng motor, jatuh cinta pada Reva dan terkejut saat mengetahui bahwa ibu tiri Reva adalah mantan kekasihnya. Sementara itu, masa depan gengnya masih belum pasti.
